title: M2cR execution record (terminal record), schema_version 1
description: Layer-4 terminal record for an M2cR execution. Frozen by prereg addendum v1.19 (milestone R1) under the author-ratified plan docs/plan-post-d45-m2cr.md. Scientific standing is a function of (record_kind, status): a result-kind COMPLETED record is a scientific result; a diagnostic-kind COMPLETED record is protocol completion only and carries not_a_result: true; ALGORITHM_STOP is reachable only by result-kind runs; ABORTED_BUDGET is an interruption, never a scientific STOP; INFRA_FAILURE and NOT_STARTED are non-scientific. This schema pins the v1.17 canonical hash as a const, which is acyclic because v1.17 references no schema; it embeds no hash of any manifest that references it, and no record carries its own digest. The R3 diagnostic-record schema is a separate artifact and is neither defined nor stubbed here.

authorization_id.description: Opaque id string naming a grant in the authorization ledger. Deliberately an id, never a ledger digest: the ledger records terminal-record digests, so citing the ledger by hash here would close a cycle.

launch_attempt_id.description: Required top-level field on every record branch, naming the launch attempt that produced this record. Deliberately NOT a member of the chain object: ballot B18 enumerates the chain's members exhaustively and the launch attempt is not among them, so this field is carried at the record's top level instead, where it remains hash-bound to the record because the ledger cites terminal records by digest (terminal_outcome / pre_payload_terminal_outcome), and that digest covers every top-level field. Author decision 2026-07-15, resolving the R1 stop question, option (c).

run_id.description: Names the committed evidence directory docs/m2c_evidence/<run_id>/.

nonfinite_sentinel.description: Frozen sentinel. Canonical serialization uses allow_nan=False, so raw nonfinite literals are rejected everywhere; nonfinite values are carried only as this closed object.

number_or_nonfinite.description: Element-level rule: every numeric element of a v2 optimizer/curvature record is a JSON number or a frozen sentinel.

finite_number.description: Scientific summary fields are plain finite JSON numbers; a COMPLETED result cannot carry nonfinite summary values by construction.

environment_freeze_manifest_sha256.description: The single digest of the R2 aggregating environment-freeze manifest, which pins the exact frozen child-environment mapping, the complete importable-artifact manifest, the interpreter pin, and the pre-boundary attestation set. Binds the record to the STATIC freeze. Per-launch realized environment attestations are Layer-2 evidence covered by RAW_MANIFEST.sha256 and are never this member.

chain_diagnostic.description: The B18-ratified effective chain, enumerated EXACTLY as ballot B18 ratifies it and as prereg addendum v1.19 §8 restates it: no member is added here. The launch-attempt id is a top-level record field, not a chain member; it is bound to the record because the record is hashed as a whole. The authorization is cited by ID STRING, never by ledger digest, so no cycle is formed.

diagnostic_record_sha256.description: sha256 of the R3 DIAGNOSTIC-RECORD INSTANCE governed by m2c_diagnostic_record.schema_v1.json (authored in R3, not here). Author determination of 2026-07-15: this follows the plan's literal terminology at §5.1/§5.2 and preserves the R3 -> R5/R6 dependency. It is NOT the diagnostic-kind terminal record. No separate terminal-record hash is added, because no ratified requirement demands one.

amendment_manifest.description: The amendment-manifest hash, or the explicit string "none" when no amendment was ratified. Only decision-table row 8 can ever authorize an amendment, and it additionally requires separate author ratification at R5.

chain_result.description: The B18-ratified effective chain, enumerated EXACTLY as ballot B18 ratifies it and as prereg addendum v1.19 §8 restates it: no member is added here. The launch-attempt id is a top-level record field, not a chain member; it is bound to the record because the record is hashed as a whole. The authorization is cited by ID STRING, never by ledger digest, so no cycle is formed.

status.description: No fabricated aggregate: the superseded rev-5 'undetermined' count is replaced by these explicit statuses.

nodes_total.description: Present only where the grid was materialized; absent otherwise.

oneOf.description: A diagnostic cap stage. Frozen rev-5 records the six earlier decade stages DIAGNOSTICALLY only, never used for the pass/fail verdict, so stage_class is bound to diagnostic and a cap stage cannot be classified as a verdict stage.

status.description: No fabricated aggregate: the superseded rev-5 'undetermined' count is replaced by these explicit statuses.

nodes_total.description: Present only where the grid was materialized; absent otherwise.

oneOf.description: A verdict stage: the level-0 grid, its nested refinements, and the two pullback grids.

stage_record.description: Per-stage record. stage_id and stage_class are bound to each other so the frozen rev-5 diagnostic-only status of the cap stages cannot be misrepresented. No fabricated aggregate: the superseded 'undetermined' count is replaced by explicit statuses.

aggregates.description: Well-defined sums only, split by verdict class versus diagnostic class.

raw_manifest_sha256.description: Layer-3 RAW_MANIFEST.sha256, taken over all Layer-2 files excluding itself and this terminal record.

event_stream_balanced.description: The ABORTED_BUDGET and INFRA_FAILURE branches admit an unbalanced partial stream, carried by digest, so a crash preserves in-flight attempt evidence up to the last flushed line.

evidence.description: Evidence block for the non-COMPLETED branches. COMPLETED uses evidence_completed, which forces a balanced stream.

event_stream_balanced.description: Frozen true. An unbalanced stream is admissible only under ABORTED_BUDGET or INFRA_FAILURE; on a protocol exit it is a capture fault.

evidence_balanced.description: Evidence block for protocol-exit records that must close their event stream (ALGORITHM_STOP). A STOP occurred at a node, so at least one per-node evidence digest exists.

event_stream_balanced.description: Frozen true: a COMPLETED payload REQUIRES a balanced event stream. An unbalanced stream is admissible only under ABORTED_BUDGET or INFRA_FAILURE, never under COMPLETED.

evidence_completed.description: Evidence block for COMPLETED records only. A COMPLETED record cannot claim completion over an unbalanced stream or an empty per-node evidence set.

stop_stage.description: Budget and infrastructure never appear in this enum.

stop_observed_values.description: Observed values at the stopping gate. Every element is a JSON number or a frozen sentinel: the frozen code can legitimately emit -inf (slogdet sign 0), +inf (grad_inf_norm), and nan (rcond at a zero maximum eigenvalue), and those must be representable rather than silently dropped.

sum.description: The audit tool checks bit-exactly that sum equals the float64 sum of lo, mid, and hi. An identity, not a tolerance.

result_payload.description: Quantiles are excluded from the result contract (ballot B17). A quantile is not finite by construction, and an unreachable level could not serialize under allow_nan=False. Quantiles may be added only through a future schema version, protocol, and authorization.

ceiling_hours.description: The wall-clock safety ceiling in force for this run. A safety ceiling, not a validated runtime prediction and not a scientific threshold.

fault_class.description: evidence_overflow is an INFRA_FAILURE, never truncation.

reconstructed.description: True only when a reconciliation mode assembled this envelope late after parent death. Raw content was runtime-captured; only envelope assembly is late.

payload_started.description: Whether payload_started.json existed. Determines whether this INFRA_FAILURE consumed the scientific authorization: consumption is derived from the payload-start event, never asserted here.

not_started_info.description: No confirmed spawn: spawned.json never appeared. NOT_STARTED consumes no authorization.

oneOf.description: Result-kind COMPLETED: a scientific result. Requires a balanced event stream and non-empty stage, realized-grid, and per-node evidence sets.
Diagnostic-kind COMPLETED: protocol completion only, never a scientific result. Carries no result_payload. Requires a balanced event stream and non-empty stage and per-node evidence sets.

record_kind.description: ALGORITHM_STOP is reachable only by result-kind runs. The diagnostic probe loop has no verdict gates, so a diagnostic-kind run can never produce this status.

branch_algorithm_stop.description: A clean protocol-exit STOP closes its event stream. An unbalanced stream is admissible only under ABORTED_BUDGET or INFRA_FAILURE; an unbalanced stream on a protocol exit is a capture fault and routes to INFRA_FAILURE by precedence rule 3.

branch_aborted_budget.description: ABORTED_BUDGET is an interruption, never a scientific STOP, and yields no scientific conclusion. It admits an unbalanced partial event stream.

branch_infra_failure.description: Non-scientific. A capture, attestation, or environment fault voids certification even if the child also exited with a protocol code.

branch_not_started.description: Non-scientific. No confirmed spawn; consumes no authorization.

persisted_axis_order.description: Canonical named axes. Ballot B1: all persisted vectors, matrices, Hessian axes, optimizer traces, and comparison points are written in canonical named axes; matrices are conjugated by the role permutation. Computation stays in E1 storage order.

computation_storage_order.description: The three E1 site names in their COMPUTATION (storage) order, preserving the frozen source/storage provenance. It does NOT change persisted array order, which is always canonical (ls, os, lv). Replaces the ambiguous frozen field name nuisance_order. R2 must test the permutation and matrix conjugation in both directions. Entries are distinct site names.

canonical_vector3.description: Three elements in canonical (ls, os, lv) order.

canonical_matrix3.description: 3x3 in canonical (ls, os, lv) axes, conjugated by the role permutation.

oneOf.description: A specific accepted optimum, named by stage and node.

warm_start_identity.description: Tagged identity: never an opaque string or hash, so the trajectory is reconstructable without self-hashes or external inference.

rng_seed.description: Frozen: RESTART_RNG_BASE (300) + START index, where index enumerates (warm=0, mode=1) at profile_integration.py:438. Exactly {300, 301} are realizable.

jitter_provenance.description: Provenance only, not a new optimizer decision. jitter_vector is the APPLIED offset (scale * draw), so resulting_start == base_start + jitter_vector elementwise; R2 must test that invariant.

starts.description: Exactly the two frozen starts in frozen order (warm, mode) per profile_integration.py:438. Ballot B12(i)'s 'both optimizer attempts' is preserved a fortiori: each start additionally carries every call it issued.

u_star.description: null when no finite record exists.

g_star.description: NaN when no finite record exists (profile_integration.py:520-523).

restart_count.description: Frozen: incremented once per start whose original attempt failed. Equals the number of starts carrying a restart attempt; R2 must test that invariant.

two_start_optimizer_record.description: The frozen two-start gate's return, with per-start per-attempt evidence the frozen gate discards (H-d).

logdet_by_h.description: Fixed-order array ordered exactly by frozen HESS_H_SWEEP = (5e-4, 1e-3, 2e-3). Not an object with float-string keys. Missing, duplicate, extra, or reordered entries are rejected. logdet is -inf when slogdet sign is 0 (profile_integration.py:559).

directional_records.description: Fixed-order array ordered exactly by frozen DIRECTION_RNG_SEEDS = (200, 201, 202). Not an object with integer-string keys. Missing, duplicate, extra, or reordered seeds are rejected. direction is the realized canonical-axis unit vector actually used.

scale.description: Aggregate frozen scale = max(1, max over sites of |FD| max).

pass.description: Equals the conjunction of the three coordinate passes. R2 must test this invariant.

fd_step.description: Realized step from the frozen rule FD_STEP_GRAD * max(1, |u_j|).
Realized step from the frozen rule FD_STEP_GRAD * max(1, |u_j|).
Realized step from the frozen rule FD_STEP_GRAD * max(1, |u_j|).

coordinates.description: Fixed canonical order exactly (ls, os, lv).

battery_record.description: Independent fresh-model central-FD battery at an accepted optimum. A gross-defect detector, not a precision-gradient claim.

u_star.description: The point this evaluation was taken at. For a fallback evaluation this is the pre-retry optimum.

raw_hessian.description: The RAW pre-symmetrization matrix at HESS_H_CENTER, which the frozen gate discards.

K.description: The symmetrized curvature 0.5*(raw + raw.T) actually used.

logdet.description: Center logdet; -inf when slogdet sign is 0.

logdet_stability_error.description: +inf when the center logdet is non-finite (profile_integration.py:577-581).

rcond.description: NaN when the maximum eigenvalue is zero (profile_integration.py:634).

symmetry_ok.description: The frozen raw-symmetry check against SYMMETRY_TOL. Row 8 of the decision table can demote this to a reported diagnostic; it remains measured and retained either way.

curvature_evaluation.description: One complete curvature evaluation, recorded in full whether pre-retry, post-retry, or a fallback evaluation.

retry.description: Tagged union. Frozen semantics: the gate rejects status != 0 and success == False alike (profile_integration.py:724).

oneOf.description: No retry fired: the single evaluation at the two-start-accepted optimum is FINAL. A post_retry evaluation is not representable here.

post_retry.description: Recorded in full, including when it evaluates the fallback point.

oneOf.description: A retry fired: both evaluations are recorded in full. post_retry is required and cannot appear without a fired retry.

curvature_record.description: Pre- and post-retry evaluations plus tagged retry telemetry. The FINAL evaluation is the single one when no retry fired, or the post-retry one at a positively accepted point.

oneOf.description: Accepted node. Per B12(i) the battery and the record-only curvature evaluation run at accepted optima ONLY, so both are required here. The outgoing warm-start identity points at this node.
Optimizer-gate failure. No battery and no curvature: B12(i) runs them at accepted optima only. selected_optimum is null and the outgoing warm start equals the incoming one.

per_node_record.description: Layer-2 per-node record, addressable by JSON Pointer #/$defs/per_node_record so R2 can validate Layer-2 files directly against this frozen contract. Layer 4 carries only its digest, never the record itself. Battery and curvature outcomes never alter continuation (B12(i)).

retry_not_fired.description: No retry fired: the pre-retry evaluation passed SPD/rcond conditioning.

trigger.description: Frozen: a retry fires ONLY on SPD/rcond conditioning failure. Per rev-5 §2c the other diagnostics are mandatory but do not independently authorize a retry.

candidate_vector.description: The retry optimizer's RAW output, at whatever shape it came back. Deliberately length-free: the frozen gate defends against a wrong-shaped return (profile_integration.py:720-722) and plan §3.2 requires v2 to record the malformed output itself. observed_shape is the shape authority; nested shapes are flattened in call order. Nonfinite elements use the frozen sentinels.

required_shape.description: Explicit shape metadata. minItems 0 so a scalar (0-d) return stays representable. observed_shape is authoritative for candidate_vector.

observed_shape.description: Explicit shape metadata. minItems 0 so a scalar (0-d) return stays representable. observed_shape is authoritative for candidate_vector.

telemetry.description: Complete retry-optimizer telemetry. A wrong-shaped candidate is recorded through observed_shape rather than an arbitrary repr.

conjuncts.description: Every conjunct of the positive retry-acceptance predicate, each an explicit boolean. Any conjunct false makes the retry a RETRY FAILURE, which decision-table row 4 routes ahead of every Hessian or amendment diagnosis.

positively_accepted.description: The conjunction of all six conjuncts.

fallback_fired.description: True when the retry returned a wrong-shaped or non-finite vector and the frozen gate re-evaluated at the pre-retry optimum (profile_integration.py:720-722).

retry_fired.description: A retry fired. Both the malformed output and the fallback evaluation are recorded.

u.description: The raw output vector, recorded even when the finiteness check fails (profile_integration.py:458, :476-487).

optimizer_attempt_original.description: The ORIGINAL minimize() call for this start. The frozen gate overwrites this result when it fails and the restart fires (profile_integration.py:446-456), discarding exactly this telemetry; v2 exposes it (diagnosis H-d).

u.description: The raw output vector, recorded even when the finiteness check fails (profile_integration.py:458, :476-487).

optimizer_attempt_restart.description: The jittered restart call, present only when the original attempt returned a non-zero SciPy status. Its jitter provenance is required.

attempts.description: Attempts for THIS start, in call order: element 0 is always the original call; element 1 is the jittered restart and is present if and only if the original returned a non-zero status. Never more than two: the frozen gate restarts at most once.

optimizer_start.description: One start of the frozen two-start gate, with every minimize() call it issued.
